from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import json

OUT=Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))

def observe(label='obs',depth=True):
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=depth,video='none')
    res.save(str(OUT/label))
    return res

def act(actions,label='act',depth=True):
    a=np.asarray(actions,dtype=float).reshape(-1,11)
    with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'actions':a.tolist()})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('delta',a,include_depth=depth,video='none',note=label)
    res.save(str(OUT/label))
    return res

if __name__=='__main__':
    obs=observe('initial')
    print(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
    print(obs.meta)

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
P=np.array(spec['arm']['position_m'])
AX=np.array(spec['arm']['axis'])
EE=np.array(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'])
CP=np.array(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['position_m'])

def fk(q,point=EE):
    R=np.eye(3); t=np.zeros(3)
    for p,axis,a in zip(P,AX,q):
        pcur=t+R@p
        Ri=Rotation.from_rotvec(axis*a).as_matrix()
        t=pcur-R@Ri@p
        R=R@Ri
    return t+R@point,R

def ik(xyz,qseed=None,down=True,Rtarget=None):
    if qseed is None:qseed=np.array([0,1.5,np.pi,-1.6,0,1.7,1.57])
    lo=np.array([-20,-2.24,-20,-2.57,-20,-2.09,-20]);hi=-lo
    def fun(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        e=(p-np.array(xyz))*5
        if Rtarget is not None:return np.r_[e,Rotation.from_matrix(Rtarget.T@R).as_rotvec()]
        if down:return np.r_[e,(R@np.array([0,0,1])-np.array([0,0,-1]))*.7]
        return e
    fit=least_squares(fun,np.clip(qseed,lo+.001,hi-.001),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=300)
    return fit.x, np.linalg.norm(fun(fit.x))

def now():return np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])

def servo(q=None,base=None,grip=0,label='servo',tol=.006,max_steps=100):
    global res
    for step in range(max_steps):
        v=now();a=np.zeros(11);a[10]=grip
        if q is not None:a[3:10]=np.clip(np.array(q)-v[6:13],-.1,.1)
        if base is not None:
            a[:3]=np.clip(np.array(base)-v[:3],-.1,.1)
            norm=np.linalg.norm(a[:2])
            if norm>.1:a[:2]*=.1/norm
        if (q is None or np.max(np.abs(np.array(q)-v[6:13]))<tol) and (base is None or np.max(np.abs(np.array(base)-v[:3]))<tol):break
        res=act([a],label+f'_{step:03d}',depth=False)
        if res.done:return res
    return observe(label+'_end')
PY

import cv2

def camera_pose(v):
    p,R=fk(v[6:13],CP)
    B=Rotation.from_rotvec([0,0,v[2]]).as_matrix()
    return np.r_[v[:2],0]+B@p,B@R

def pixels_world(uv,depth,v):
    p,R=camera_pose(v)
    f=240/np.tan(np.deg2rad(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['fovy_deg'])/2)
    u,vv=np.asarray(uv).T
    local=np.stack([-(u-319.5)/f,-(vv-239.5)/f,np.ones_like(u)],axis=-1)*np.asarray(depth)[...,None]
    return local@R.T+p

def red_objects(label):
    path=OUT/label
    img=cv2.imread(str(path/'last/robot_wrist.jpg'))[:,:,::-1]
    dep=np.load(path/'depth_robot_wrist.npy')[-1].astype(float)
    v=np.array(json.loads((path/'meta.json').read_text())['proprio']['now'])
    mask=((img[:,:,0]>45)&(img[:,:,0]>img[:,:,1]*1.7)&(img[:,:,0]>img[:,:,2]*1.6)&(img[:,:,1]<65)).astype('uint8')
    n,lab,stats,cent=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)
    items=[]
    for i in range(1,n):
        if stats[i,4]<8:continue
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i);uv=np.stack([xs,ys],axis=-1)
        xyz=pixels_world(uv,dep[ys,xs],v)
        items.append((stats[i,4],cent[i].tolist(),np.median(xyz,axis=0).tolist()))
    return items

def ik_near(xyz,seed,Rtarget=None):
    if Rtarget is None:
        _,R=fk(seed);z=np.array([0,0,-1.]);x=R[:,0];x[2]=0;x/=np.linalg.norm(x);Rtarget=np.column_stack([x,np.cross(z,x),z])
    lo=np.array(seed)-np.pi;hi=np.array(seed)+np.pi
    lo[[1,3,5]]=[-2.24,-2.57,-2.09];hi[[1,3,5]]=[2.24,2.57,2.09]
    def fun(q):
        p,R=fk(q)
        return np.r_[(p-np.array(xyz))*10,Rotation.from_matrix(Rtarget.T@R).as_rotvec()*2,(q-seed)*.015]
    fit=least_squares(fun,np.clip(seed,lo+.001,hi-.001),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=500)
    return fit.x,fun(fit.x)
PY

def pixel_floor(uv,v,z=.0,cam='robot_wrist'):
    if cam=='robot_wrist':
        p,R=camera_pose(v)
        f=240/np.tan(np.deg2rad(spec['cameras'][cam]['fovy_deg'])/2)
        u,vv=np.asarray(uv).T
        ray=np.stack([-(u-319.5)/f,-(vv-239.5)/f,np.ones_like(u)],axis=-1)@R.T
    else:
        cp=spec['cameras'][cam]['pose'];B=Rotation.from_rotvec([0,0,v[2]]).as_matrix()
        p=np.r_[v[:2],0]+B@np.array(cp['position_m'])
        f=240/np.tan(np.deg2rad(spec['cameras'][cam]['fovy_deg'])/2)
        u,vv=np.asarray(uv).T
        ray=(np.array(cp['forward'])+((u-319.5)/f)[...,None]*np.array(cp['right'])-((vv-239.5)/f)[...,None]*np.array(cp['up']))@B.T
    return p+ray*((z-p[2])/ray[...,2])[...,None]

def push(dx,dy,n,label,q=None,grip=1):
    v=now()
    if q is None:q=v[6:13].copy()
    basegoal=v[:3].copy()
    for i in range(n):
        basegoal[:2]+=[dx,dy]
        a=np.zeros(11);a[:3]=np.clip(basegoal-v[:3],-.06,.06);a[3:10]=np.clip(q-v[6:13],-.1,.1);a[10]=grip
        res=act([a],f'{label}_{i:03d}',depth=False)
        v=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])
        if res.done:return res
    return observe(label+'_end')
